applicationDescription: Quick IT announcement creation for Outlook.
title: Title
helpContent:
How to use the application:

  1. Select the announcement type.
  2. Fill in the required fields.
  3. Review the live preview.
  4. Click Copy to Outlook.
  5. Paste directly into Outlook using CTRL+V.

Available types:

  • 📢 Information
  • 🔧 Maintenance
  • 🚨 Incident
  • 📣 Alert

Visible fields automatically change based on the selected announcement type.

IT Announcement Generator for Outlook
